_schema.binding_note: This block is the shared vocabulary for ALL ginger domain JSON files. Every subsequent domain MUST reuse these exact field names, units, codes and enums. Do not introduce synonyms. Pass this file alongside the next domain document so the schema is inherited.

divergence_from_sugarcane_kb.area_unit: Sugarcane KB used per hectare (e.g. organic_input_t_ha). Ginger KB uses PER ACRE throughout, because the farmer plans in acres. Original per-hectare figures are preserved in source_note on every converted value.
divergence_from_sugarcane_kb.no_filler_rules: Every rule in this file is traceable to a specific statement in the source document. Rule count is an outcome, not a target.
divergence_from_sugarcane_kb.confidence_bounded: confidence_score is bounded 0.0-1.0. Values above 1.0 are invalid.

source_tiers.A: Institutional Maharashtra source (state agricultural university, ICAR, government) or peer-reviewed research
source_tiers.B: Extension portal or national institutional source (Vikaspedia, TNAU, Spices Board)
source_tiers.C: Commercial or blog source; yield and profit figures from tier C are treated as unreliable

source_classes.SRC-Q: quantified figure taken directly from a source
source_classes.SRC-D: descriptive statement in source; value inferred
source_classes.FIELD: to be measured on the plot
source_classes.VERIFY: must be confirmed with a named institution before production use

priority_scale.5: blocking or highest yield impact; must not be missed

farm_brain_fields.soil_type: enum:[vertisol, loam, sandy_loam, laterite, red_loam, other]

geography_binding.note: All values are bound to this geography. Do not apply elsewhere without revalidation.

language.note: Both generated from one structured advisory object; never translated from each other.

AUTO_DECISION.mr: AI कधी व किती हे स्वतः ठरवतो
AUTO_DECISION.en: engine computes the quantity or timing itself

SENSOR_ALERT.mr: sensor वर आधारित इशारा, कृती माणसाची
SENSOR_ALERT.en: sensor-triggered; the action is human work

DIAGNOSTIC.en: engine asks, farmer answers, engine branches

DATA_CAPTURE.en: engine requests a record or measurement

POLICY.en: product policy; never reaches a farmer

automation_levels.full: engine decides and acts without asking
automation_levels.assisted: engine decides when, the person does the work or supplies the observation
automation_levels.advisory: engine shows the arithmetic, the person chooses

trigger_dsl.unknown_rule: A rule whose trigger evaluates UNKNOWN must NOT fire and must NOT be treated as FALSE. Report reduced confidence and name the missing field (Domain 12 D12-COLD-001).
operators: IS NULL / IS NOT NULL / IS TRUE / IS FALSE
trigger_dsl.note: Fields resolve against kb_farm_brain_fields. An undeclared name is a parse error, never a silent false.

notification_policy.why: The season simulation issued 998 messages across 301 days before this existed. A trigger expresses a condition and a condition stays true; the advice is an event and must be delivered once.

classes.ONCE_UNTIL_RESOLVED: Standing precondition. Once, then a 7/21/45/90 day ladder with rising severity.
classes.EVENT: Transient physical event. Rising edge only; re-armed after it clears.
classes.WINDOW: Dated operation. Advance warning, the day, then 3 overdue reminders.
classes.SILENT_GUARD: Prevention rule. No message unless the prohibited action is attempted.

notification_policy.result: 998 messages became 43 in the normal season, with no critical stage left silent for more than 15 days.

override_policy.why: The Tier-1 review worked but was offline. An agronomist looking at a live plot in August cannot edit JSON and wait for a deploy; by then the window has closed.
override_policy.scope_precedence: narrowest wins — plot over cluster over global
override_policy.expiry_rationale: A permanent change belongs in the knowledge base, not in the override table.
override_policy.immutable_rationale: Some rules exist because getting them wrong causes harm no agronomic judgement outweighs. The API refuses them by code path, and a database trigger refuses them again if the application layer is bypassed.
override_policy.audit: Refused attempts are recorded, not discarded. An attempt to override an immutable rule is a governance signal.

metadata.validation_note: Compiled from published sources. NOT yet reviewed by a practising agronomist and NOT yet tested against field data. Status must not be upgraded until Kasbe Digraj contact and one season of plot records are complete.
metadata.rule_count_note: 22 is the number of distinct, traceable rules the source document supports. No rules were generated to reach a target count.
metadata.review_note: Agronomy here is stable for several years. Only variety availability needs periodic recheck.
metadata.purpose: Stage-aware lifecycle rules for ginger under Kannad belt conditions. Every rule ties to the Farm Brain field schema and, where quantified, to a Domain 11 u-value.
key_innovations: GDD arm explicitly DISABLED — no reliable published series for ginger exists, so a plausible-looking number was not invented.
Flowering (हुरडे बांड) treated as a physiological turning point that closes the earthing-up window, not as a cosmetic event.
Yield ceiling carries a declared uncertainty (94 vs 113 q/acre) instead of a single confident number.
Prediction interval widens when destructive sampling is skipped, because the yield organ is invisible.

yield_targets_quintal_per_acre.ceiling_basis: Mahima 94 q/acre genetic capacity x 1.20 broad-ridge multiplier
yield_targets_quintal_per_acre.ceiling_uncertainty: If variety trials already used broad ridge, ceiling is 94 not 113. Treated as range until confirmed.

rejected_target.reason: 6.6x state average and ~3.8x best variety genetic capacity. Management can reach genetic potential, not exceed it. An inflated target propagates wrong fertiliser and water doses to every farmer, because doses are computed in proportion to expected yield.

primary_sources: Agrowon - Ale Lagvad Tantradnyan, Dr. Jitendra Kadam, Halad Sanshodhan Yojana, Krishi Sanshodhan Kendra, Kasbe Digraj, Sangli (TIER A)
Agrowon - Drip irrigation and fertigation for ginger, Anil Bitle & Arun Deshmukh, Netafim Irrigation India, Pune (TIER A)
ICAR-AICRP on Spices - Package of Practices, Ginger (TIER A)
Spices Board / TNAU Agritech - Ginger bulletin (TIER B)
Directorate of Agriculture Maharashtra 2023 via AgriTimes (TIER A)
District Profile, Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar, Government of Maharashtra (TIER A)
Springer - soft rot management study, seed treatment germination figures (TIER A)
AgroWorld - Ale (Adrak) Lagvad (TIER C - used for descriptive practice only, NOT for yield or profit figures)
metadata.tier_c_handling_note: AgroWorld and similar commercial sources reported variety yields in tonnes per ACRE where institutional sources report the same varieties in tonnes per HECTARE — a 2.47x discrepancy. Institutional figures were used. This same error was independently found in a second commercial source, confirming the correction.

review_log.note: Rule-level status is authoritative. Domain status stays PHASE_1_RAW_UNVALIDATED until T3 and T4 are also reviewed and one season of field data exists.

phenology.gdd_disabled_reason: No reliable published GDD series for ginger in Indian conditions was located. Staging runs on calendar + farmer-observable marker only. A plausible number was deliberately not invented.

stages.note: Declared as a stage so advisory can run before day zero. Decisions here place more yield at risk than any single in-season stage.

marker.mr: कोंब जमिनीबाहेर येणे; प्रति चालू मीटर मोजणी
नमुना रोप उकरून बोटे मोजणे; मातीचे फुगणे व भेगा
नमुना रोपाचे वजन वाढणे; माती स्पष्ट फुगलेली
पाने पिवळी व वाळणे; सालीची चाचणी

varieties.note: Listed as a distinct local variety. No figures available. Indicates ginger has an older local tradition in this district than assumed. Worth enquiring with local seed traders and older farmers.

vocabulary.note: not seed in the botanical sense; vegetative planting material
highly local term; not in general Marathi corpora

trigger.english: Date is after 7 June AND planting has not yet occurred
trigger.marathi: ७ जून उलटला आहे आणि लागवड झालेली नाही
trigger.expr: planting_date IS NULL AND MONTH IN [JUN, JUL] AND dap IS NULL
trigger.expr_note: Planting window has closed and nothing is planted.

action.english: BLOCK normal planting advisory. State that the window has closed. Present the choice explicitly: skip the season, or accept the risk. If proceeding, double all rhizome fly and soft rot preventive measures.
action.marathi: आले लागवडीची मुदत ७ जून रोजी संपली आहे. यानंतर लागवड केल्यास कंदमाशी व कंदकूज यांचा प्रादुर्भाव मोठ्या प्रमाणावर होतो. हा हंगाम वगळावा, किंवा जोखीम स्वीकारून लागवड करावी — पण तसे केल्यास कंदमाशी व कंदकूज प्रतिबंध दुप्पट करावा.

reasoning.agronomic_basis: Official window is 15 April to first week of June. Rhizome fly peaks July-August; timely planting means the crop is 60-90 days old and robust by then. Late planting leaves it soft and vulnerable at exactly the wrong moment.
reasoning.yield_impact: u = 0.20. At 113 q/acre ceiling and Rs 4000/quintal this is roughly Rs 90,000 per acre.
references: Agrowon - Dr. Jitendra Kadam, Kasbe Digraj

rules.kannad_note: This is the single highest-value zero-cost rule in the domain. It requires no input, only a date. In a belt where every other precondition (drip, mulch, beds) costs money, this one is free.

review.comment_mr: The planting-window concept is supported, but the exact 7 June cutoff, doubled prevention claim and fixed u=0.20 loss are not sufficiently universal. Make the cutoff region/variety/advisory-source specific and remove the fixed loss unless locally validated.

trigger.english: Month is May or early June AND planting not yet done
trigger.marathi: मे किंवा जूनची सुरुवात, लागवड बाकी
trigger.expr: MONTH IN [MAY, JUN] AND days_to_planting BETWEEN 1 AND 20
trigger.expr_note: The habit conflict: every other kharif crop says wait for rain, ginger says do not.

action.english: Warn that ginger timing is opposite to other kharif crops. Cotton and soybean are sown after the monsoon establishes; ginger must be planted before it.
action.marathi: अद्रक हे इतर खरीप पिकांसारखे नाही. कापूस-सोयाबीन पाऊस आल्यावर पेरतात; अद्रक पाऊस येण्यापूर्वी लावावे लागते. ७ जून ही शेवटची मुदत आहे — पावसाची वाट पाहू नका.

reasoning.agronomic_basis: Monsoon normally covers most of Maharashtra by 10 June, but the ginger deadline is 7 June. A farmer habituated to cotton and soybean timing will wait for rain and miss the window.
reasoning.yield_impact: Prevents the u = 0.20 loss in D01-PW-001 by acting before the deadline rather than reporting it after.

rules.kannad_note: Marathwada monsoon onset is unreliable and 55 percent of years fall below average rainfall. Waiting for rain here is a worse bet than in the western belt.

review.comment_mr: The pre-monsoon planting principle is sound, but the exact May/early-June window must follow the locally approved ginger planting window and current extension advice.

trigger.english: moisture_probe_depth_cm greater than 20
trigger.expr_note: Probe outside the rhizome zone invalidates every moisture rule.

action.english: BLOCK all moisture-derived advisory. Require the sub-node capacitive probe to be repositioned into the 0-20 cm band before planting.
action.marathi: अद्रकाची मुळे ०-३० सेंमीमध्ये आहेत, बहुतांश ०-२० सेंमीमध्ये. Probe यापेक्षा खोल असल्यास तो पीक वापरत नसलेल्या मातीचे वाचन देतो. लागवडीपूर्वी probe ०-२० सेंमीमध्ये आणावा.

reasoning.agronomic_basis: Ginger is shallow-rooted and the rhizome grows horizontally; the entire working zone is the top 30 cm. A probe set for a deep-rooted crop samples a different soil volume altogether.
reasoning.yield_impact: Not a yield factor in itself. It invalidates every moisture threshold in Domain 3, so its effect is to corrupt the largest single advisory stream.

rules.kannad_note: The sub-node was originally built and installed for sugarcane on this plot. A deep reading is not merely imprecise here, it is irrelevant, and irrelevant readings are more dangerous than wrong ones because nobody checks them.

review.comment_mr: 0–20 cm probe placement is a useful operational gate, but the exact 0–20 cm universal sensing depth should remain soil/root-zone calibrated. Keep the gate; validate depth by field and soil profile.

trigger.english: planting_date and variety are known
trigger.marathi: लागवड तारीख व जात माहीत आहे
trigger.expr: dap BETWEEN 0 AND 35 AND STAGE IN [G1]

action.english: Compute current_stage from DAP using the variety duration profile. Set stage_source to calendar and confidence to medium.
action.marathi: लागवडीच्या तारखेवरून व जातीच्या कालावधीवरून सध्याची अवस्था काढा.

reasoning.agronomic_basis: Stage boundaries scale with variety duration; a 200-day variety reaches rhizome initiation earlier than a 240-day one.
reasoning.yield_impact: Indirect. Every time-bound rule in every domain depends on the stage being right.

rules.kannad_note: Duration profiles are estimated, not measured. First-season observations should correct them for this belt.

review.comment_mr: Recording planting date and variety as the foundation for stage calculation is agronomically and operationally sound.

trigger.english: A farmer-observable marker has been recorded
trigger.expr: dap BETWEEN 33 AND 40 AND establishment_pct IS NULL
trigger.expr_note: Establishment is a hard ceiling and the count has a narrow window.

action.english: Re-anchor the stage clock to the marker. Marker overrides calendar. Set stage_source to marker and raise confidence.
action.marathi: निरीक्षणाची खूण दिसल्यास तिच्यावरून अवस्था ठरवा — दिवस मोजणीपेक्षा ती जास्त विश्वासार्ह आहे.

reasoning.agronomic_basis: Calendar days drift with season and variety. Observable markers do not drift. A mis-entered planting date otherwise mistimes every downstream event for the whole season.
reasoning.yield_impact: Indirect but broad. Protects the timing of earthing-up, fertiliser splits and harvest.

rules.kannad_note: Especially important where the GDD arm is disabled, because calendar is otherwise the only clock.

review.comment_mr: Farmer-observable stage markers are useful, but marker definitions must be crop/variety-specific and consistently recorded before they drive rules.

trigger.english: Engine attempts GDD-based staging
trigger.expr: dap BETWEEN 90 AND 150 AND STAGE IN [G3]
trigger.expr_note: Rhizome initiation. Water and potassium matter most here.

action.english: REFUSE. The GDD arm is disabled for ginger. Fall back to calendar plus marker and state the reason if asked.
action.marathi: अद्रकासाठी GDD पद्धत बंद आहे. दिवस मोजणी व निरीक्षण यावरच अवस्था ठरवा.

reasoning.agronomic_basis: No reliable published GDD series for ginger in Indian conditions was located. Sugarcane has a validated base temperature and thermal-time model; ginger does not.
reasoning.yield_impact: None directly. Prevents false precision, which is worse than declared uncertainty.
references: absence of source across ICAR-IISR, KAU, TNAU

rules.kannad_note: Once the cluster weather station has one full season of data, a local GDD series can be derived for this belt. That would be FIELD-class data that exists in no publication.

review.comment_mr: Disabling unsupported GDD staging for ginger and falling back to calendar plus validated phenology markers is appropriate until a validated Indian ginger thermal-time dataset exists.

trigger.english: flowering_observed is true (हुरडे बांड)

action.english: Re-anchor stage. Then CHECK earthing_up_date. If earthing-up has not been recorded, the window has closed — record a 12.5 percent yield penalty for Domain 11 gap attribution and inform the farmer plainly.
action.marathi: हुरडे बांड आले आहे. आता पानांची वाढ थांबून गड्ड्याची वाढ सुरू होते. उटाळणी झाली नसल्यास तिची मुदत संपली आहे आणि उत्पादनात १०-१५% घट गृहीत धरावी लागेल.

reasoning.agronomic_basis: Source states that after the flowering spike opens, leaf growth stops and rhizome growth begins. Earthing-up must precede this because it triggers new fibrous root formation, which needs time before bulking starts.
reasoning.yield_impact: u = 0.125. Skipping earthing-up costs 10-15 percent yield, roughly Rs 56,500 per acre at 113 q ceiling and Rs 4000/quintal.

rules.kannad_note: Version 2.0 of this document wrongly recorded flowering as requiring no management action. That error would have removed a 12.5 percent yield factor from the engine entirely. Corrected in v2.1.

review.comment_mr: Flowering can be a stage marker, but the fixed 12.5% yield penalty is unsupported as a universal value. Re-anchor stage and evaluate earthing-up status, but remove the fixed penalty unless locally validated.

trigger.english: dap equals 35

action.english: Request establishment count per running metre and record establishment_pct. This number sets the ceiling for the whole season.
action.marathi: उगवण मोजा — प्रति चालू मीटर किती रोपे उगवली. हा आकडा पुढील संपूर्ण उत्पादनाची कमाल मर्यादा ठरवतो. ८५% पेक्षा जास्त उत्तम; ७०% पेक्षा कमी असल्यास कारण शोधावे.

reasoning.agronomic_basis: Ginger has no ratoon and gap filling produces plants that never catch up. Establishment is therefore a hard ceiling, not a starting point.
reasoning.yield_impact: Directly proportional. A 70 percent establishment caps the season at 70 percent of potential regardless of later management.
references: Springer seed treatment study germination figures

rules.kannad_note: If establishment is below 70 percent, diagnose before gap filling. If the cause is rot, replanting simply wastes a second lot of the most expensive input on the farm.

review.comment_mr: An establishment count around 35 DAP can be useful, but the rule must define sampling method, sample size and acceptable stand range from a validated planting-density standard.

trigger.english: dap equals 120 AND sample_dig_120_done is false
trigger.expr: dap BETWEEN 118 AND 124 AND sample_dig_120_done IS FALSE
trigger.expr_note: The yield organ is invisible. A dug sample is the only real measurement.

action.english: Request destructive sample of one plant. Checklist: finger count (3-5 expected), firmness, colour, smell, root condition. A sour or rotten smell is an immediate escalation to Domain 6.
action.marathi: एक नमुना रोप उकरून पहा. ३-५ स्पष्ट बोटे असावीत, भरीव व टणक, रंग फिकट पिवळसर, वास ताजा. कुजका वास आल्यास तात्काळ कळवा.

reasoning.agronomic_basis: The yield organ is invisible. Partially infected plants stay green above ground while the rhizome is already compromised, so surface appearance is unreliable.
reasoning.yield_impact: Enables early detection of the largest single factor (soft rot, u up to 0.70) while neighbouring plants can still be protected.

rules.kannad_note: Cost of one sacrificed plant is negligible against Rs 1.45 lakh invested per acre. Running the season blind is the expensive option.

review.comment_mr: A 120-DAP destructive sample is useful for early crop diagnosis, but '3–5 fingers expected' is not a universal maturity/yield standard. Keep as a scouting sample and validate expected morphology locally.

trigger.english: dap equals 180

action.english: Request destructive sample and weight, compared against the 120 DAP sample. Also trigger D01-VR-002 seed selection reminder. Set yield_prediction_interval_pct to 8 if done, 12 if skipped.
action.marathi: नमुना रोप उकरून वजन करा आणि मागील तपासणीशी तुलना करा. वजन जेमतेम वाढले असल्यास पालाश व ओलावा तपासा.

reasoning.agronomic_basis: Bulking rate between 120 and 180 DAP is the best available predictor of final yield, and there is no non-destructive substitute.
reasoning.yield_impact: Improves prediction accuracy by roughly one third. Does not change yield itself, but changes every decision that depends on the forecast.

rules.kannad_note: This is the rule that makes the prediction interval honest. Skipping the dig does not make the forecast worse, it makes the stated uncertainty larger — and the engine must say so rather than quietly reporting the tighter number.

review.comment_mr: A 180-DAP destructive sample is useful for calibration, but the automatic 8%/12% yield-prediction interval is not justified by the cited agronomy. Replace with a statistically calibrated model uncertainty.

trigger.english: variety is not set AND planning phase
trigger.expr_note: u = 0.138 between the best and weakest of the four main varieties.

action.english: Recommend Mahima for the main area. Alternate Varada. If dry ginger is the strategic route, consider Rejatha. Fallback to Mahim only if the first three are unavailable locally.
action.marathi: मुख्य क्षेत्रासाठी महिमा. ती सूत्रकृमी प्रतिकारक असल्याने अप्रत्यक्षपणे कंदकूज व मर रोगापासूनही संरक्षण देते — आणि तो फायदा फुकट आहे, फक्त योग्य बेणे निवडून. न मिळाल्यास वरदा; सुंठ हाच मार्ग असल्यास रीजाथा.

reasoning.agronomic_basis: Mahima leads on yield (94 q/acre), tiller count (12-13) and lowest fibre (3.26 pct), and is nematode resistant. Nematode wounds are a documented entry route for both soft rot fungi and Ralstonia wilt, so resistance here is indirect disease control at zero cost.
reasoning.yield_impact: u = 0.138 against Mahim, the weakest of the four. Roughly Rs 62,400 per acre.

rules.kannad_note: Local availability is the real constraint. Maharashtra has only about 4000 ha under ginger, so the seed market is thin. Order at least five months ahead or the choice is made for you.

review.comment_mr: Mahima/Varada/Rejatha can be presented as documented options, but recommending Mahima as the main area variety requires local market, disease, seed availability and trial evidence. Do not make a universal 'best variety' claim.

trigger.english: dap equals 180
trigger.expr: dap BETWEEN 178 AND 184 AND sample_dig_180_done IS FALSE
trigger.expr_note: Seed selection is a mid-season observation task disguised as a post-harvest one.

action.english: Remind the farmer to mark healthy vigorous plants for next season's seed NOW, while the crop is still green. This selection cannot be made at harvest. BLOCK this advice entirely if field_history_rot or field_history_wilt is true.
action.marathi: पुढील हंगामाचे बेणे आत्ताच निवडा. पीक हिरवे असतानाच निरोगी, जोमदार रोपे खुणावून ठेवावी लागतात — काढणीच्या वेळी ही निवड करता येत नाही.

reasoning.agronomic_basis: Seed selection is a mid-season observation task disguised as a post-harvest one. Vigour and disease-freedom are only visible on the standing crop.
reasoning.yield_impact: Affects next season, not this one. Poor seed carries u = 0.20 to 0.50 into the following crop.

rules.kannad_note: This is one of the four commonly forgotten actions. It costs nothing and is worth roughly 40 percent of next season's largest cost line.

review.comment_mr: Selecting healthy, disease-free seed plants before harvest is agronomically sound. The exact 180-DAP timing is operational and should be linked to variety/stage; keep the disease-history block.

trigger.english: Farmer intends to retain own seed AND field_history_rot or field_history_wilt is true
trigger.marathi: स्वतःचे बेणे राखायचे आहे पण या प्लॉटवर रोगाची नोंद आहे

action.english: Advise strongly against retaining seed from this plot, regardless of the cost comparison. Ralstonia survives in soil for many years and travels with planting material.
action.marathi: या प्लॉटवर कंदकूज किंवा मर रोगाची नोंद असल्याने इथून बेणे राखू नये. खर्चाचा फायदा एका रोग-प्रवेशापुढे टिकत नाही.

reasoning.agronomic_basis: Bacterial wilt bacterium is notorious for persisting in soil for many years and has a wide host range. Seed rhizome is the primary introduction vector for both wilt and soft rot.
reasoning.yield_impact: Prevents u = 0.30 to 0.70 in the following season.
references: Springer - Journal of Plant Pathology 2020, bacterial wilt review

rules.kannad_note: The field history record is the input here, and it only exists if the app has been keeping it. This is precisely the asset that paper records and farmer memory do not preserve across years.

review.comment_mr: Do not retain seed from fields with rot/wilt history is a strong disease-management principle. The exact pathogen persistence statement should be source-specific; retain the block with a validated disease basis.

trigger.english: Pre-season planning initiated

action.english: Present the yield target as a RANGE with three levels: minimum viable 60, target 90, stretch 110 quintal per acre. Never present a single number.
action.marathi: उत्पादन लक्ष्य श्रेणीत मांडा — किमान ६०, लक्ष्य ९०, ताणून ११० क्विंटल प्रति एकर. मराठवाड्याच्या काळ्या जमिनीत ११० क्विंटल मिळवणे हे राज्य सरासरीच्या (५३) दुपटीहून जास्त आहे.

reasoning.agronomic_basis: Genetic capacity of the best variety is 94 q/acre; broad ridge adds up to 20 percent. The stated range spans realistic to excellent under Kannad conditions.
reasoning.yield_impact: Sets the denominator for every dose calculation in Domains 3 and 4.
references: Directorate of Agriculture Maharashtra state average

rules.kannad_note: The ceiling itself carries declared uncertainty of 94 to 113 q/acre depending on whether variety trials already used broad ridge. This is open item D01-OI-05 and it is blocking for Domain 11.

review.comment_mr: A yield target range is preferable to a single target, but 60/90/110 q/acre must be treated as planning scenarios, not scientific yield standards, until local multi-season validation.

trigger.english: yield_target_quintal_per_acre exceeds the ceiling computed for this variety, layout and plot
trigger.marathi: उत्पादन लक्ष्य या जात, लागवड पद्धत व शेतासाठी काढलेल्या कमाल मर्यादेपेक्षा जास्त आहे

action.english: Warn rather than reject. Compute the ceiling from the variety rating, the planting layout and the plot record instead of applying one fixed number. Where the target exceeds it, show the computed ceiling and ask what supports the higher figure. Do NOT scale fertiliser or water doses to a target the ceiling does not support.
action.marathi: थेट नाकारण्याऐवजी इशारा द्या. एकच ठराविक आकडा न लावता जात, लागवड पद्धत आणि शेताच्या नोंदींवरून कमाल मर्यादा काढा. लक्ष्य त्याहून जास्त असल्यास काढलेली मर्यादा दाखवा आणि जास्त आकड्याला आधार काय आहे ते विचारा. मर्यादेला आधार नसलेल्या लक्ष्यावर खत किंवा पाण्याच्या मात्रा काढू नका.

reasoning.agronomic_basis: Best recorded variety capacity is 94 q/acre. Even with the full broad-ridge multiplier and optimal drip the theoretical maximum is about 130. EXPERT AMENDMENT: 130 quintal per acre is not a hard limit. The ceiling varies with variety, management and region, so the rule warns and shows its working rather than rejecting outright.
reasoning.yield_impact: Prevents systematic dose error across every input domain. Fertiliser and irrigation are computed in proportion to expected yield, so an inflated target corrupts all of them simultaneously.

rules.kannad_note: The original plot target of 350 quintal per acre came from an earlier advisory and is 6.6 times the state average. This rule exists because that number nearly entered the rule base and would have mis-dosed every farmer on the platform.

review.comment_mr: १३० क्विंटल/एकर कठोर मर्यादा नसावी; जात, व्यवस्थापन व प्रदेशानुसार बदलते.

superseded.action_en: WARN and explain. Do NOT recompute fertiliser or water doses against the inflated target. Explain that management can reach genetic potential but cannot exceed it.
superseded.author_reasoning: Hard ceiling to stop fertiliser and water doses being scaled to an unsupported target.

trigger.english: air_temp_max_c above 35 AND stage is G0 or G1
trigger.marathi: कमाल तापमान ३५ अंशांवर आणि पीक हंगामापूर्व किंवा उगवणीच्या अवस्थेत
trigger.expr_note: Expert amendment lowered this from 38 C. Protection begins where scorching is documented to start.

action.english: Escalate mulch and irrigation-timing advisory. Confirm stage 1 mulch is in place. Split drip into morning and evening runs. Do not irrigate at midday.
action.marathi: आच्छादन घातले आहे का ते तपासा. ठिबक सकाळ-संध्याकाळ दोन पाळ्यांत चालवा, दुपारी नको. उघड्या काळ्या जमिनीचे तापमान हवेपेक्षा बरेच जास्त असते आणि बेणे भाजू शकते.

reasoning.agronomic_basis: Optimal soil temperature for sprouting is 25-26 C. Recorded maxima in this district reach 45.9 C, and bare black soil surface runs hotter than air. Leaves scorch above 35 C. EXPERT AMENDMENT: threshold lowered from 38 C to 35 C. The expert judged the earlier figure unsafe — protection should begin at the point where scorching is documented to start, not above it.
reasoning.yield_impact: u = 0.12 estimated for absent stage-1 mulch under heat stress.

rules.kannad_note: Ten of the twelve crop months have suitable temperatures here. The single mismatched month is May, which is also the planting month. All protective effort should be concentrated in the first five weeks.

review.comment_mr: ३८°C ऐवजी ३५–३६°C पासून संरक्षण सुरू करणे अधिक सुरक्षित.

superseded.trigger_en: air_temp_max_c greater than 38 AND stage is G0 or G1
superseded.action_en: Escalate mulch and irrigation-timing advisory. Confirm stage 1 mulch is in place. Split drip into morning and evening runs. Do not irrigate at midday.
superseded.author_reasoning: Author estimate; source states only that leaves scorch above 35 C.

trigger.english: Stage is G4 AND month is between November and January
trigger.expr: MONTH IN [NOV, DEC, JAN] AND STAGE IN [G4]
trigger.expr_note: The Marathwada winter is close to ideal for bulking. Kerala does not have this.

action.english: Inform that conditions are now favourable and that the priority shifts from protection to supply — consistent moisture and potassium.
action.marathi: आता तापमान गड्डा भरण्यासाठी अनुकूल आहे. या काळात पीक वाचवण्यापेक्षा भरू देणे महत्वाचे — ओलाव्यात सातत्य आणि पालाश.

reasoning.agronomic_basis: Optimal temperature for rhizome growth is 18-20 C. December average here is 20.8 C. This is a genuine local advantage not available in Kerala or Konkan, where winters remain warm.
reasoning.yield_impact: Not a loss factor. It identifies the window in which the largest share of yield is actually laid down.

rules.kannad_note: The whole season strategy compresses to: May-June defend against heat, July-September defend against water, October-January let the crop fill. Yield is decided in the third phase, but only if the first two are survived.

review.comment_mr: The 18–20°C rhizome-growth concept is plausible, but the exact G4/Nov–Jan window depends on the stage framework and local variety. Use it as a contextual advisory, not a universal optimum.

trigger.english: dap greater than or equal to 200
trigger.expr: dap BETWEEN 205 AND 240 AND harvest_date IS NULL

action.english: Advise the skin scrape test as the primary maturity indicator. Secondary signs are leaf yellowing and pseudostem lodging. Day count is the least reliable of the three.
action.marathi: गड्डा उकरून अंगठ्याने साल घासा. साल सहज निघते म्हणजे अपक्व; साल घट्ट बसलेली म्हणजे पक्व. ही चाचणी दिवस मोजण्यापेक्षा जास्त विश्वासार्ह आहे आणि तिला कोणतेही उपकरण लागत नाही.

reasoning.agronomic_basis: Maturity varies with variety, season and planting date, so day count drifts. Skin corking is a direct physiological indicator.
reasoning.yield_impact: Premature harvest carries u = 0.10 to 0.15 and much larger storage losses.

rules.kannad_note: Simplest high-value test in the whole knowledge base. Needs a thumb.

review.comment_mr: 200 DAP is a valid reference for some ginger varieties such as IISR-Mahima, but not a universal harvest date. Use variety-specific maturity plus physiological maturity test.

trigger.english: Leaf yellowing reported AND dap less than 200
trigger.marathi: पाने पिवळी पडली पण २०० दिवस झालेले नाहीत
trigger.expr: leaf_yellowing_pattern IS NOT NULL AND dap < 200
trigger.expr_note: Yellowing before 200 DAP is not maturity.

action.english: BLOCK the maturity conclusion. Redirect to the yellowing diagnosis tree. Do not allow harvest planning on this signal.
action.marathi: पाने पिवळी पडली म्हणजे पक्वता नव्हे. या भागात पिवळेपणाची किमान सहा वेगळी कारणे आहेत आणि उपाय पूर्णपणे वेगळे आहेत. आधी निदान करा — मुळाजवळची माती ओली आहे का, सुरळी मेली आहे का, कोणती पाने पिवळी — जुनी की नवी.

reasoning.agronomic_basis: In this belt leaf yellowing has at least six causes: nitrogen deficiency, iron or zinc lock-up from free lime, waterlogging, soft rot, bacterial wilt, and heat scorch. Treatments differ and two of them make the situation worse if misapplied.
reasoning.yield_impact: Prevents both a premature harvest and, more importantly, a missed rot diagnosis worth up to u = 0.70.

rules.kannad_note: Calcareous soil yellowing is expected here and will look like nitrogen deficiency. Urea applied to it does nothing except grow foliage at the rhizome's expense.

review.comment_mr: पाने पिवळी = पक्वता असे समजू नये.

trigger.english: dap greater than or equal to 180

action.english: Present the four harvest routes with their trade-offs. Do NOT recommend one. This is an economic decision and belongs to Domains 9 and 13.
action.marathi: चार पर्याय मांडा — लवकर हिरवे (१८० दिवस), पूर्ण पक्व हिरवे (२३० दिवस), सुंठ करून लगेच विक्री, किंवा सुंठ करून साठवणे. हा आर्थिक निर्णय आहे, कृषिशास्त्रीय नाही.

reasoning.agronomic_basis: Green ginger can be harvested from about six months; full maturity for processing needs eight. A crop that is 75 percent mature is still marketable.
reasoning.yield_impact: Route choice affects weight, dry recovery, storability and realised price, not yield potential.

rules.kannad_note: Dry ginger matters more here than in wetter belts because the local market is thin — state daily arrivals are about one percent of onion — and storage capacity is the only real bargaining power a grower has.

review.comment_mr: Presenting multiple harvest routes without recommending one respects the economic decision. The route descriptions and maturity gates must remain crop/market specific.

trigger.english: target_product is seed_rhizome AND harvest is being considered before full maturity
trigger.marathi: बेण्यासाठीचे पीक पूर्ण पक्वतेपूर्वी काढण्याचा विचार
trigger.expr_note: Immature seed does not survive four to five months of storage.

action.english: REFUSE early harvest for seed crop. Full maturity is mandatory. Immature rhizome does not survive storage and does not sprout the following season.
action.marathi: बेण्यासाठीचे पीक कधीही लवकर काढू नये. अपक्व गड्डा साठवणीत टिकत नाही आणि पुढच्या हंगामात उगवत नाही.

reasoning.agronomic_basis: Skin corking and dry matter accumulation complete only at full maturity, and both determine storage survival over the four to five month gap to next planting.
reasoning.yield_impact: Affects next season. Failure here compounds into establishment loss and wasted seed cost, the largest input line.

rules.kannad_note: Seed rhizome already loses 28 to 40 percent of its weight in storage. Starting that clock with an immature rhizome makes the loss worse and the germination unreliable.

review.comment_mr: Seed-rhizome harvest should use physiological maturity and variety-specific maturity, not a universal DAP<235 block. Replace with a maturity-test gate; 235 DAP is not valid for all ginger varieties.

trigger.english: current_stage is G1, G3 or G4
trigger.marathi: पीक उगवण, गड्डा तयार होणे किंवा गड्डा भरणे या अवस्थेत

action.english: Flag critical irrigation window to Domain 3. Tighten moisture tolerance band, raise sensor sampling frequency, and escalate advisory severity by one level.
action.marathi: ही निर्णायक सिंचन अवस्था आहे. ओलाव्याची सहन-मर्यादा घट्ट करा, sensor वाचन वाढवा, आणि इशाऱ्याची तीव्रता एक पातळी वर न्या.

reasoning.agronomic_basis: Published irrigation guidance names germination, rhizome initiation and rhizome development as the critical stages. This matches the criticality ranking derived independently from crop physiology.
reasoning.yield_impact: Moisture stress in G3 prevents finger differentiation and is irrecoverable. u = 0.15 to 0.25.
references: ICL Growing Solutions ginger crop nutrition

rules.kannad_note: G3 and G4 fall in September to December here, exactly when the monsoon has ended and the entire water load shifts to the well. This is the hardest period to serve and the most costly to fail.

review.comment_mr: Critical irrigation windows should be tied to validated ginger phenology. Keep the cross-domain escalation, but do not hard-code G1/G3/G4 as universal critical stages until stage definitions are validated.

open_items.item: Confirm planting and harvest window for Kannad taluka specifically
Record which variety is actually planted on the plot
Local availability and price of Mahima / Varada seed rhizome
Base temperature and usable GDD series for ginger in Indian conditions
Whether the published variety trial yields already used broad ridge layout
open_items.note: Determines whether the ceiling is 94 or 113 quintal per acre. Every Domain 11 u-value computation and every Domain 13 scenario depends on this single answer.

open_items.item: Aurangabadi landrace — duration, yield, disease behaviour
Confirm the sub-node moisture probe can be repositioned to 0-20 cm

next_steps: 1. Resolve D01-OI-05 with Kasbe Digraj — it is blocking for Domains 11 and 13
2. Reposition moisture probe to 0-20 cm before planting (D01-OI-07)
3. Build Domain 2 JSON inheriting this _schema block unchanged
4. Cross-validate D01-PH-004 flowering trigger against Domain 8 earthing-up rules
5. Do NOT upgrade status from PHASE_1_RAW_UNVALIDATED until agronomist review and one season of plot records exist
author_note: This file contains 22 rules because that is what the source document supports. Rule count is deliberately not a target. Every rule carries a traceable source, a bounded confidence score, and a Kannad-specific note. Where a value is estimated rather than sourced it is marked EST, and where it must be confirmed with a named institution it is marked VERIFY. Status is PHASE_1_RAW_UNVALIDATED and must remain so until an agronomist has reviewed it and one season of field records exists.
